calculation_handling.description: Where the lot has a value on the Lot Coverage Overlay Map, that value is the maximum lot coverage as a percentage of lot area.
Where the lot has no value on the Lot Coverage Overlay Map, no lot coverage limit applies (unregulated).
On a lot abutting a major street, a townhouse or apartment building may cover at most 50 percent of the lot area, despite (A) and (B).
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires a major-street abutment test; apartment buildings are outside MaxBLD building types.

calculation_handling.description: Where the mapped lot coverage is under 45 percent and the lot holds a detached houseplex OR a residential building with a secondary suite, all buildings and structures may cover up to 45 percent. The houseplex / secondary-suite test is a disjunction; it is carried in application (building type detached_houseplex, lot condition has_secondary_suite) because condition tokens are a conjunction.
calculation_handling.gaps: The either/or (houseplex or secondary suite) needs the user's building type and suite answer; the limit covers all buildings and structures on the lot, not only the principal building.

10.20.30.40(1).explanation: Lot coverage in the RD zone comes from the Lot Coverage Overlay Map. If the map shows a value for your lot, that percentage of the lot area is the most your buildings may cover. If it shows none, no coverage limit applies. On a lot that abuts a major street, a townhouse or apartment building may cover up to 50 percent. If the map value is under 45 percent and the lot has a detached houseplex or a house with a secondary suite, all buildings together may cover up to 45 percent.
